$description: Lucide icon (as shadcn's registry names it) → the Carbon icon unicron draws in its place. A value is a Carbon svg name from packages/ui/src/icons/names.json, or { "element", "from" } to swap the icon for a component (the spinner is an arc of its own, not an icon). The transform stops on a Lucide name that is not here, and on a Carbon name that is not in the curated set.
